title: Climate SaaS UI and UX Redesign

assessment_snapshot.intro: The existing frontend is a Next.js and React climate-risk SaaS with Tailwind styling, Framer Motion, and several dashboard workflows:
bullets: Next.js 14 App Router and React 18 are already in use
Tailwind CSS theme tokens and custom UI components exist
Framer Motion is already installed; the product has climate, simulation, and emergency views
No screenshot or reference design was attached

proposed_outcome: Polish the existing frontend in place into a coherent, minimal climate-intelligence SaaS experience with clear grids, thoughtful color combinations, subtle Framer Motion, and tasteful river-and-tree motifs. Preserve existing routes, data behavior, and product workflows while improving visual hierarchy, responsive behavior, and accessibility.
